body_lead: - Write a comment In a move to improve road safety, the Uttar Pradesh government has received a green flag to implement an AI-based pilot project from the Union Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH). With this, Uttar Pradesh has become the first state government to enact such a unique project in India. Let us take a look at more details of this upcoming programme: More Details To enforce the trial project, the Uttar Pradesh Government has set aside Rs 10 crore in its fiscal budget for 2025-26.
